newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HEINEKEN SAYS NO COMMENT ON TEMPO OPTION.
newsitem.headline: HEINEKEN SAYS NO COMMENT ON TEMPO OPTION.

text.p: Dutch brewer Heineken NV said on Tuesday it could not comment on reports it was in talks on buying a 44.5 percent stake in Israeli brewer Tempo.
"We know we are cited as one of the candidates, and we are regularly in contact with Tempo on the basis of the cooperation agreement we have with them."
"We are looking at the possibilities, but will not make any comment before there's something to announce," said Heineken spokeswoman Margritha Meijer.
Israel's Tempo Beer Industries Ltd said earlier today that its controlling shareholders had reached an agreement aimed at making Heineken a shareholder and strategic partner.
In a statement to the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange, Tempo said Podhorzer Enterprises had granted an option to sell its 44.5 percent share in Tempo for $42 million to a shareholder group.
The option is conditional on the shares being bought by Heineken within 90 days, the statement said. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
